title: Clinical Negligence Paralegal
description:
Clinical Negligence Paralegal
Location: Birmingham/Hybrid

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Clinical Negligence Paralegal to join a supportive and growing legal team.

Responsibilities
- Manage a supervised caseload
- Assist senior solicitors with complex clinical negligence matters
- Liaise with clients and medical experts
- Undertake legal research
- Prepare documentation
- Support cases through pre- and post-issue procedures

Key Requirements
- Law-related degree, graduate qualification or relevant professional training
- Previous legal experience, ideally within clinical negligence
- Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
- Excellent written communication and client care skills
- High attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines
- A proactive approach and willingness to work under supervision

What's on Offer?
- Hybrid and flexible working
- 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays and Christmas closure
- Bonus scheme and pension
- Health benefits and life assurance
- Enhanced family-friendly benefits
- Ongoing training, development and career progression
- Supportive working environment and team culture

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their legal career while contributing to meaningful clinical negligence cases.

Click on the link to apply or contact James Durkan at G2 Legal for more information.

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.

title: Residential Conveyancing Legal Assistant, Solihull, National Law Firm
description:
Residential Conveyancing Legal Assistant, Solihull, National Law Firm

Are you an experienced Conveyancing Legal Assistant looking to join a friendly and established Residential Property team where you can build on your experience and play an important part in progressing transactions?

This is an opportunity to join a national law firm within its Solihull office, supporting experienced Residential Conveyancers across a varied caseload.

The Firm

A well-established national law firm with offices across England and a substantial Residential Property offering.

The Solihull office offers the benefit of working within a close-knit local team while still having the resources, systems and career opportunities associated with a larger national practice.

The Role

Working closely with Residential Conveyancers, you'll provide hands-on support throughout the conveyancing process and help ensure transactions progress efficiently from instruction through to completion.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Opening and maintaining conveyancing files
- Preparing and issuing documentation
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders and other solicitors
- Assisting with searches and Land Registry matters
- Supporting exchanges and completions
- Dealing with post-completion administration

You'll have plenty of client contact and will play an important role in keeping transactions moving, rather than simply providing general administrative support.

You

You'll ideally already have experience working within a Residential Conveyancing department, whether as a Legal Assistant, Conveyancing Assistant or in a similar property support role.

You'll need to be organised, comfortable managing competing priorities and confident communicating with clients and other parties involved in transactions.

Good attention to detail is important, alongside the ability to work effectively as part of a busy property team.

If you've built up conveyancing experience and want to join a larger firm where you can continue developing your knowledge and career, this could be a strong next move.

Benefits
- Competitive salary
- Generous annual leave
- Career development and progression opportunities
- Support and training from experienced Conveyancers
- Benefits associated with an established national law firm

Would you like to join a supportive Residential Property team where you'll be genuinely involved in progressing transactions and developing your conveyancing experience?

For further information or a confidential conversation about the opportunity, please get in touch.
